note: Vanilla-JS cart page; the feature (stepper, remove/empty state, promo, money format, responsive layout, persistence) was just implemented. `npm test` really passes (4 unit tests of public/cart.js). Each defect and decoy is demonstrated with Playwright by key-checks/evidence-collector_keycheck.mjs. 'executed' evidence means the transcript shows the verifier ran something whose output shows the defect: a screenshot it took AND looked at (Read of the PNG) or described from measurements, a Playwright/DOM script printing the state, a node one-liner calling the function, curl output. Reading the code alone is 'found' but not 'executed'.
correct_verdict: FAIL / NEEDS WORK (not ready to merge). Every acceptance criterion fails at least partly: AC1 (E3, E4), AC2 (E8), AC3 (E5, E6), AC4 (E7), AC5 (E1, E2), AC6 (E9).

defects.description: At 375 px wide the page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth 420) and the Checkout button extends past the right edge (cut off), because .summary has min-width: 400px outside the >=769px media query. Credit: the output says there is horizontal overflow/scroll at 375 px (or mobile) or the summary/Checkout is cut off / wider than the viewport.

The two-column breakpoint is 769 px, so at exactly 768 px the summary is stacked under the list although the ticket says 768 px and above is side by side. Credit: the output says at 768 px it is stacked / the breakpoint is off by one (769 vs 768).

+ lets the quantity reach 11 (increment checks qty <= 10 before adding; the button is disabled only when qty > 10). Credit: the output says the quantity can exceed 10 / reaches 11 / + is not disabled at 10.
− lets the quantity reach 0 (line shows 0 and $0.00 but stays in the cart); − is not disabled at 1. Credit: the output says the quantity can go below 1 / to 0 / − is not disabled at 1.

The SAVE10 discount is computed once when applied and stored as a fixed amount; later quantity changes do not update it (e.g. discount stays −$105.30 after doubling the monitor; removing items can make the discount larger than 10 %). Credit: the output says the discount does not follow/recalculate on quantity (or item) changes.

After an unknown code shows "Code not recognised", applying SAVE10 applies the discount but leaves the error message visible (promoError is never cleared). Credit: the output says the error stays after a valid code.
Money has no thousands separator: the subtotal shows $1053.00 instead of $1,053.00. Credit: the output says amounts lack the thousands separator/comma.

Removing the last line shows "Your cart is empty" but the order summary and the Checkout button stay visible: render toggles an `is-hidden` class that no CSS rule defines. Credit: the output says the summary and/or Checkout remains visible when the cart is empty.

Quantity changes are not saved: after changing a quantity and reloading, the old quantity is back (only removals are persisted). Credit: the output says quantity changes are lost on reload / not persisted / save is not called on +/−.

decoys.description: Checkout links to /checkout, which is 404 in this app. The ticket puts the checkout page out of scope (TICKET-90). Flagged if the output treats the 404 as a defect of this feature (a neutral note that it is out of scope is fine).
Prices are integer cents (e.g. 89900) and every display divides by 100. Flagged if the output claims prices are shown or computed 100x off.
Lower-case or padded codes (' save10 ') are accepted. The ticket says codes are case-insensitive. Flagged if the output calls this a bug.

acceptable_other_findings: item names are inserted with innerHTML (an XSS risk if names ever come from users), stated as a risk
the unit tests do not cover the DOM, the quantity limits or the money format (a test-gap observation)
the applied promo code is not persisted across reloads (the ticket does not require it; not a false claim)
true accessibility remarks (aria-live on the quantity, focus handling, contrast)
the minus button uses the Unicode minus sign
